en.title: Beethoven: String Quartet Op. 18 No. 5, I. Allegro – A Listening Guide
en.overview: This is a fast movement in A major. It is in 6/8, so the beat has a lilting "one-two-three, four-five-six" swing. The first violin plays the opening tune at the very start. That tune comes back in the first violin in the middle of the second big section. Listen for the shift to a bright new key in the first part, the darker minor-key turns in the middle, and the soft, then loud, ending. The harmony labels in the source are expert-made, so the keys are reliable. The "lead" part is a rough guess, so treat low-confidence spots as shared.

listening_points.headline: The opening tune in the first violin
listening_points.text: The first violin plays the main theme on top, over a soft accompaniment [m. 1-3]. Bar 1 carries loud and accented markings (f, sfp, sf), but the tune soon settles to soft. Bar 4 is a lone, exposed line [m. 4].

listening_points.headline: Tune flows on, then swells to a loud push
listening_points.text: The violin keeps singing over soft support [m. 5-16]. The lines thicken into chords moving together [m. 17-18]. Then the music grows louder [m. 21-22] and reaches forte (loud) at [m. 23]. It is still in A major.

listening_points.headline: A darker turn to E minor
listening_points.text: The mood darkens as the key moves to E minor [m. 25-30]. It opens with the instruments playing the same line in unison or octaves [m. 25]. A brief flash of G major brightens the mood [m. 31-32]. Then E minor returns. It is loud at first [m. 33], then drops to soft [m. 34] and to very soft [m. 36].

listening_points.headline: Bright, hushed E major; the middle voices step up
listening_points.text: The music brightens into E major, played very softly [m. 37-42]. At [m. 43] the second violin steps forward. Then only three parts play (a trio), and the lead is probably shared between the second violin and the viola [m. 44-47].

listening_points.headline: Loud, punchy E major with sharp accents
listening_points.text: Suddenly the music is loud at [m. 48]. Soft and loud then alternate [m. 49-51]. A run of sharp accents follows in the loud stretch [m. 52-58]. It stays loud until it drops to soft at [m. 66].

listening_points.headline: Viola solo, then a calm close of Part 1
listening_points.text: The viola plays alone for one bar [m. 67]. The music builds and has a loud moment [m. 72-73]. It then settles to soft repeated phrases [m. 74-78]. The cello leads the end of this part, in E major [m. 79a-80]. Part 1 is repeated.

listening_points.headline: Part 2 begins in octaves, then turns loud and chordal
listening_points.text: Part 2 starts with the instruments playing one line together in octaves [m. 81]. Then it turns loud and chordal [m. 82-87]. The key shifts to D major [m. 86]. The music drops to a whisper at [m. 88].

listening_points.headline: Quiet D major, with an estimated loud peak at bar 101
listening_points.text: Quietly, bars of tune-and-accompaniment alternate with bars where the parts move on their own lines [m. 89-98]. The viola takes a turn leading [m. 99-100]. The analysis marks [m. 101] as the busiest loud moment. After that it falls back to soft and light duets and trios [m. 103-107].

listening_points.headline: Darker keys: D minor, then A minor
listening_points.text: The key turns to D minor [m. 108-113]. The mood is tenser. The same idea repeats in A minor [m. 115-127]. It reaches a loud peak [m. 117] and then calms again. The playing is very soft by [m. 127].

listening_points.headline: Home key returns, and the opening tune comes back
listening_points.text: A major comes back, whispered [m. 128]. The music swells louder [m. 132-135]. Then the first violin plays the main theme again, exactly as at the start [m. 136-138]. It is back in the home key, A major, and soft again.

listening_points.headline: Cello surprises, then another loud build
listening_points.text: Then the music wanders to unexpected notes [m. 151-158]. The cello leads, and loud and soft flash by turns. It then builds up again to a loud moment [m. 161-163].

listening_points.headline: Minor again, with a brief flash of C major
listening_points.text: A minor returns, with the same dark mood as before [m. 164-170]. For two bars it brightens to C major [m. 171-172]. It returns to A minor loudly [m. 173], then drops to soft and finally very soft [m. 174-176].

listening_points.headline: Hushed A major, then loud accents again
listening_points.text: A major returns, very soft [m. 177-187]. At [m. 183] the second violin steps forward. Then only three parts play (a trio), and the lead is probably shared [m. 184-187]. A loud bar [m. 188] is followed by soft and loud in turn [m. 189-191], then a run of loud accents [m. 192-198].

listening_points.headline: Viola solo, octaves, and soft phrases before a loud second ending
listening_points.text: The loud, punchy music goes on [m. 199-205]. It softens at [m. 206]. The viola plays alone [m. 207]. The parts then play octaves and a loud burst [m. 211-213]. Soft repeating phrases close the section [m. 214-218]. Part 2 is repeated.

listening_points.headline: A soft start, then a loud close on the home chord
listening_points.text: The short final part starts softly [m. 221]. It swells [m. 222-223]. It ends loudly, with a strong push from the dominant chord (the chord that wants to resolve) to the home chord [m. 224-225]. The home key is A major.

glossary.explanation: The home note and scale that a passage feels centred on. Major keys sound bright. Minor keys sound darker.
Several instruments play the same notes, at the same pitch or at different heights.
All parts move together in chords, a bit like a hymn.
One part plays the tune while the others support it.
Only three (trio) or two (duet) of the four instruments are playing.
A sudden sharp accent on one note or chord.
The chord that builds tension and wants to resolve to the home chord.
Part 1 and Part 2 are each played twice.

zh.title: 贝多芬:弦乐四重奏 Op. 18 No. 5 – 第一乐章 Allegro 聆听指南
zh.overview: 这是一个 6/8 拍的快板乐章,主调是 A 大调。本乐章分三大块:第一部分、第二部分和很短的结尾。第一、二部分都要重复。请留意第一小提琴那条轻快的主旋律,它在开头出现,在第二部分中途又原样回来。也请留意调性的明暗变化,以及忽强忽弱的对比。

listening_points.headline: 第一小提琴唱出主旋律
listening_points.text: 乐章在 A 大调中开始:第 1 小节带有强(f)和突强(sfp、sf)记号,随后主旋律在轻声(p)中展开。第一小提琴拿着主旋律,其他三件乐器在下面伴奏 [m. 1-3]。第 4 小节其他乐器停下,只剩第一小提琴独自演奏 [m. 4]。之后旋律继续,整体保持轻柔 [m. 5-16]。

listening_points.headline: 声音渐渐变大,推向第一次强奏
listening_points.text: 第 17-18 小节,各声部以相同节奏一起移动,形成和弦式(主调)织体 [m. 17-18]。经过渐强(声音一点点变大)[m. 21-22],到第 23 小节达到强(f)。这几小节第一小提琴和大提琴大概是共同领头。

listening_points.headline: 转入 E 小调,气氛变暗
listening_points.text: 第 25 小节起转到 E 小调,色彩比 A 大调暗一些。几件乐器先用同一条线或八度齐奏 [m. 25]。中间短暂闪过 G 大调,像一瞬间的亮光 [m. 31-32]。随后又回到 E 小调 [m. 33-36]。

listening_points.headline: E 大调,很弱的悄悄话
listening_points.text: 第 37 小节转到 E 大调,色彩重新明亮。但声音仍保持很弱(pp)[m. 37]。第 44 到 47 小节只有三件乐器在演奏,这叫三重奏织体。这里领头的大概是第二小提琴,但把握不大。

listening_points.headline: 突然转强,重音接连出现
listening_points.text: 第 48 小节声音一下变响。第 49-51 小节轻(p)和强(f)交替出现 [m. 49-51]。到第 52 小节后持续强奏,并不断出现重音 sf(突然加重) [m. 52-65]。听起来既有力又有些急迫。

listening_points.headline: 回到轻声,中提琴和大提琴现身
listening_points.text: 第 66 小节声音又收回到 p(轻)。第 67 小节是中提琴独奏,很容易听出来。接着第一小提琴继续带着旋律走 [m. 68-78]。第一部分的末尾由大提琴领头 [m. 79a-80]。这一部分之后会重复。

listening_points.headline: 第二部分开始,转向 D 大调
listening_points.text: 第二部分在第 81 小节开场,几件乐器先齐奏同一条线。接着声音转强 [m. 82]。到第 86 小节转入 D 大调,调性发生变化。随后声音一下子变得很轻 [m. 88]。

listening_points.headline: D 大调:弱—强—弱,估计第 101 小节最响
listening_points.text: 先是很弱(pp),“旋律加伴奏”的小节和各声部独立进行的小节交替出现 [m. 89-98]。中提琴随后接过旋律 [m. 99-100]。按分析,第 101 小节是本乐章最密集的强奏点之一。这几小节没有明显的单一领头者,更像大家共同参与。之后又回到弱(p),只剩二重奏和三重奏 [m. 103-107]。

listening_points.headline: 转入 D 小调和 A 小调,色彩转暗
listening_points.text: 第 108 小节转到 D 小调,色彩变暗。之后从第 115 小节起进入 A 小调。声音先渐强,到第 117 小节变强 [m. 111-117]。接着很快降下来,最后在第 127 小节降到 pp(很弱)。

listening_points.headline: 回到 A 大调,主旋律原样归来
listening_points.text: 第 128 小节回到 A 大调,先是很弱(pp)。接着渐强,第 134 小节变强。从第 136 小节起,乐章开头的主旋律由第一小提琴原样奏出,而且调性和一开始一样。听到它就像回到了家。

listening_points.headline: 开头再现后,大提琴带来意外转折
listening_points.text: 第 139 小节又是第一小提琴独奏,之后的旋律与开头很像 [m. 139-150]。从第 151 小节起各声部线条各走各的,和声也开始游走。第 152 到 158 小节大提琴很可能是领头声部。强弱也在 f 和 p 之间来回变化 [m. 154-157]。

listening_points.headline: 第一部分的小调材料重现
listening_points.text: 第 159 到 164 小节:第 161-162 小节渐强,第 163 小节到强(f),第 164 小节又回到弱。第 165 小节起在 A 小调中,几件乐器再次齐奏。第 171-172 小节短暂转亮到 C 大调,随后回到 A 小调,先强 [m. 173],再突然变弱,第 176 小节到很弱(pp)[m. 173-176]。这段和第一部分第 25-36 小节相对应,同样是小调,只是换成了 A 小调。

listening_points.headline: A 大调中的悄悄话
listening_points.text: 第 177 小节回到 A 大调,仍是很弱(pp)。这段和前面 E 大调的那段非常相似。第 184 到 187 小节又是三件乐器的三重奏。领头的大概是第二小提琴。

listening_points.headline: 强奏和重音再度爆发,然后收回
listening_points.text: 第 188 小节突然变响。第 192 小节后强奏持续,并有一连串重音 [m. 192-205]。到第 206 小节声音降回 p。第 207 小节是中提琴独奏。

listening_points.headline: 收束与短小的结尾
listening_points.text: 第 207 小节起标有渐强,第 211 小节几件乐器齐奏,随后转强 [m. 211-213]。第二部分在第 220b 小节结束。第 221 小节起是只有五小节的结尾,声音渐强,在第 224 小节变强。乐章最后在 A 大调上结束。

glossary.explanation: 乐章里最重要、最容易记住的那条曲调。这里由第一小提琴在开头奏出。
一段音乐的“家”。大调听起来较明亮,小调听起来较暗淡。
音乐从一个调换到另一个调,色彩常随之变亮或变暗。
pp 是很弱,p 是弱,f 是强,sf 是突然加重某个音。
几个声部是怎么配合的,例如一个唱旋律、其他伴奏,或者大家一起走。
几件乐器同时奏同一条线,有的高八度或低八度。
四件乐器中只有三件在演奏。
第一部分和第二部分各会再演奏一遍。
